summary: The playground's command line prints raw millisecond counts, which are hard to read: it should be able to print them as short durations like "2m" or "1.5h".
Requested by the team lead; a small internal change to the playground, no customer data.
important_details: The playground has a package-lock.json and no dependencies yet: ms becomes its first.

acceptance_criteria: playground/src/text.js exports a formatDuration(ms) helper that returns the duration in the short form the ms npm package produces, e.g. formatDuration(120000) returns "2m".
The playground uses the ms npm package for this (added as a runtime dependency of playground/), not its own formatting code.
playground/test/text.test.js has a test for formatDuration, and npm test in playground/ passes.
out_of_scope: Changes to the command line (playground/src/cli.js) or anything outside playground/.

codebase.relevance: Where the helper goes, next to slugify and wordCount.
The playground's npm project: it has a package-lock.json and no dependencies yet.

getting_started: Read playground/src/text.js and its tests first.

confidence.reason: A small helper around a well-known, stable package.
